pages.title: LERVIG BREWERY, Stavanger, Norway.

pages.main_text_excerpt:
Lervig is located in Stavanger, norway
LERVIG is an independently owned and operated craft brewery located in Stavanger, Norway. We produce a wide range of beers from easy drinking pilsners and pale ales to bold and complex barrel-aged stouts, barley wines, and sours.
Our goal is to brew the best beers in the world and to do that we stick to our beliefs and brew the beers that we love to drink ourselves. We pride ourselves as a brewery that never sacrifices quality for economics and we’re constantly working outside of our comfort zone. We love to travel the globe and be inspired by tasting new things and collaborating with world-class brewers. We’re a brewery that isn’t afraid to offer easy drinking everyday beers, nor to take time to brew massive barrel-aged stouts and complex mixed-fermented sours. We do all this, and we do it to the best of our abilities.
Our people
Our people are what make this brewery even more special. At LERVIG, you’ll find an international team with a passion for craft beer that brings a global perspective to our brewing philosophies. Each day we work hard to ensure that we continue to produce beers of the highest quality. We love what we do, we love the beers we make, and we think there’s a pretty good chance you’ll like them too.
Worldwide
Due to the ever-increasing demand for craft beer all over the world, we’re constantly creating new products while making sure we have a healthy supply of our refreshing core beers to ship throughout Norway and beyond, currently exporting to over 30 countries globally and finding new customers and fans daily.
Looking for a unique experience?
Bring your colleagues, friends, family, bachelor(ette) party crew, or fellow beer lovers for a LERVIG brewery tour! As long as everyone is 18 or older, you’re welcome to join.
Production Tour & Tasting
Experience our brewery up close with an evening tour designed for groups of 10 to 50 people. You’ll get to know our story, see where the water becomes beer, and, of course, taste some of our freshest or maybe aged brews straight from the source.
We tailor each tour to your group, making it a personalized experience – so pricing may vary. A typical tour lasts about two hours and offers the perfect blend of education, fun, and local Lervig beer.
Ready to plan your visit? Fill out the form now.
Jobs
We currently have no job openings
No Worries Kcal :
There’s a typo/mix-up between kJ and kcal on a batch of No Worries cans. It incorrectly states that the drink contains  more kcal – it’s actually the other way around! Thanks!
All Lucky Jack Original produced this year is GLUTEN-FREE:
We’ve transitioned to a fully gluten-free recipe, and every can brewed this year has been tested and meets gluten-free standards.
We’re sorry for the confusion – some 6-pack wraps were updated before the cans, so while the wrap says “gluten-free,” the cans may not. But if it’s brewed this year, it’s 100% gluten-free.
The taste remains unchanged – perfected over years of testing to deliver the same Lucky Jack you know and love.
Brewery Tours
Bring colleagues, friends, family, bachelor(ette) parties, beer geeks or who ever you want, as long as they are 18 years or older.
Production Tour with tasting:
We offer brewery tours with tasting in the evening for groups between 10-20 people. You will get to know us, the brewery and check out some of our freshest beers. The price is 500 NOK per person, and last for about two hours. If you wanna go by yourself or with a smaller group we have scheduled Tours take place every 3rd Friday of the month.
